entities.summary: Peng Xiaomin (b. 1973-04-08, Yongnian District) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Yongnian District and China. Known in the fields of china, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
